goal: Implement a pure offline Workshop product-evidence assembler with explicit fixture and staging outcomes; preserve all eight release gates.
acceptance_tests: Strict versioned envelope rejects malformed, stale, duplicate, untrusted or incomplete evidence without executing candidate code.
Disabled paid/browser/staging profiles cannot yield fixture or staging verification.
Fixture counts derive from exact raw cases 5+8+14+12+120+21; supporting CI and reviews add zero cases.
Current DTO CI upload artifact is bound to exact candidate, archive digest and raw browser inventory.
Eight independent policy reports remain required for staging; fixture cannot grant deployment or cutover authority.
Pure inline synthetic negative tests, independent exact-commit review and later profile promotion are required.
forbidden_scope: Changing the autonomy policy or weakening required checks
Changing the requested gpt-6.1-sol / medium / Fast execution profile or silently falling back to another model or tier
Editing paths outside the assigned scope
Editing runner, orchestrator, policy, schema, registry, workflow, Compose, Kubernetes, application or SQL paths
Executing Docker, browser, cloud, provider or arbitrary commands from the assembler
Publishing secrets or private source payloads
Treating synthetic fixture tests as real acceptance or deployment authorization

compatibility.api: Preserve existing consumers with additive versioned fields; run compatibility checks.
compatibility.events: Preserve event identity and make duplicate delivery idempotent.
compatibility.schema: Forward-only additive migrations with clean and upgrade verification; no destructive edits to historical migrations.
